x-aisa-source.authority: Official HTML structured schemas plus pinned SDK wire envelopes; converted, not downloaded OpenAPI
x-aisa-source.request_body_required_basis: All selected create methods have required SDK payload arguments; Client.request wraps payload in data.
x-aisa-source.response_status_basis: Client.request accepts response.ok; no exact success status inferred.
limitations: No schema types or required fields inferred from examples.
Offer-request create/get alternate view responses remain untyped.
Source declarations do not prove current execution compatibility.

2XX.description: Successful HTTP response; fixed SDK accepts response.ok.

items.description: Each seat map is for a specific segment

cabins.description:
The list of cabins in this seat map.

Cabins are ordered by deck from lowest to highest, and then within 
each deck from the front to back of the aircraft.

items.description:
A cabin is a physical section of an aircraft that passengers travel 
in. The cabin that a passenger travels in will depend on the fare 
they paid (for example an economy cabin versus a business class cabin).

aisles.description:
The number of aisles in this cabin. 

If this is set to `1`, each row of the cabin is split into two sections.
If this is set to `2`, each row of the cabin is split into three sections.

cabin_class.description: The cabin class that the passenger will travel in on this segment

deck.description:
Level 0 is the main deck and level 1 is the upper deck above that, 
which is found on some large aircraft.

rows.description:
A list of rows in this cabin. 

Row sections are broken up by aisles. Rows are ordered from front to 
back of the aircraft.

items.description:
A cabin row has one or more sections, each made up of
elements.

An element is something that takes up physical space such as a
seat or an empty area.

sections.description:
A list of sections.

Each row is divided into sections by one or more aisles.

items.description:
A section within a row that contains a list of row
elements. This corresponds to a left, middle, or right
lengthwise section of the aircraft.

elements.description: The elements that make up this section

oneOf.description:
A seat for a passenger. If the `available_services` list is
empty (which will be represented as an empty list : `[]`),
the seat is unavailable.

For display, all seats should be displayed with the same static width.

available_services.description:
Seats are considered a special kind of service. There
will be at most one service per seat per passenger. A
seat can only be booked for one passenger. If a seat has
no available services (which will be represented as an
empty list : `[]`) then it's unavailable.

items.description:
A bookable seat is a special kind of service. Only one seat can be booked per
passenger, per segment

id.description: Duffel's unique identifier for the resource

passenger_id.description: The passenger that this seat is for

total_amount.description: The total price of the seat, including taxes

total_currency.description:
The currency of the `total_amount`, as an [ISO 4217](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217) currency code.
If an offer or order is priced with balance, it matches your organisation's billing currency. If it is priced with card or airline credit, it is returned in the currency the airline charges in. If it is priced without payment methods and not using Duffel Content, it is returned in the agency point of sale currency.

items.title: Seat Service

designator.description:
The designator used to uniquely identify the seat, usually made up of a 
row number and a column letter

disclosures.description:
Each disclosure is text, in English, provided by the airline that 
describes the terms and conditions of this seat. We recommend showing 
this in your user interface to make sure that customers understand any 
restrictions and limitations.
example: Do not seat children in exit row seats
Do not seat passengers with special needs in exit row seats

items.description: An individual term, condition or restriction for this seat

name.description:
A name which describes the type of seat, which you can display in your 
user interface to help customers to understand its features

oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Seat Element

oneOf.description:
A bassinet is a child's cradle. This element
will be aligned with the corresponding seat in
the following row.

For display, this element should have the same width as a
seat for proper alignment.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Bassinet Element

oneOf.description:
An empty space used for padding in some non-standard
seat arrangements.

For display, this element should have the same dimensions
as a seat for proper alignment.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Empty Element

oneOf.description:
An exit row represents the extra wide space used to reach
aircraft exits, and indicates the existence of an exit
door.

For display, this element should ideally fill or shrink to
available space in a row section. Displaying it with the same
width as seat is also reasonable.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Exit Row Element

oneOf.description:
A lavatory for use by passengers.

For display, this element should ideally fill or shrink to
available space in a row section. Displaying it with the same
width as seat is also reasonable.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Lavatory Element

oneOf.description:
A galley is the compartment where food is cooked
or prepared. These are conventionally marked
with a teacup symbol.

For display, this element should ideally fill or shrink to
available space in a row section. Displaying it with the
same width as seat is also reasonable.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Galley Element

oneOf.description:
A closet used for storage. These are
conventionally marked with a clothes hanger
symbol.

For display, this element should ideally fill or shrink to
available space in a row section. Displaying it with the
same width as seat is also reasonable.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Closet Element

oneOf.description:
A set of stairs to another deck.

For display, this element should ideally fill or shrink
to available space in a row section. Displaying it with
the same width as seat is also reasonable.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Stairs Element

oneOf.description:
A seat with restrictions on who can book it.

For display, this element should ideally fill or shrink
to available space in a row section. Displaying it with
the same width as seat is also reasonable.
oneOf.title: Cabin Row Section Restricted Seat Element

wings.description:
Where the wings of the aircraft are in relation to rows in the cabin.

The numbers correspond to the indices of the first and the last 
row which are overwing. You can use this to draw a visual 
representation of the wings to help users get a better idea of 
what they will see outside their window.

The indices are 0th-based and are for all rows, not just those that have
seats.

This is `null` when no rows of the cabin are overwing.

first_row_index.description:
The index of the first row which is overwing, starting from 
the front of the aircraft.

last_row_index.description:
The index of the last row which is overwing, starting from 
the front of the aircraft.
